skill.name: longbridge-quant
skill.description: Longbridge Quant provides workflows for quantitative research using Longbridge market data. It covers indicator scripts, pairs trading, volatility regimes, seasonality, multi-factor ranking, factor screening, hedging, execution modeling, optimization, and ML prediction.
skill.summary: Build Longbridge-based quant research, screening, hedging, and strategy validation workflows.
skill.author: longbridge

security_audit.summary: Most static detections are markdown backtick formatting, finance terminology, or benign Longbridge CLI documentation. Confirmed risks are limited to user-defined script execution through Longbridge, one package-install recommendation, and sensitive portfolio-position access in the hedging workflow.

remediation.issue: User-defined indicator scripts are sent to an external execution service.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user confirmation before longbridge quant run. Warn users not to include secrets or proprietary strategy logic unless they accept that transfer.

remediation.issue: The hedging workflow can fetch portfolio positions with trade-scope access.
remediation.suggestion: Ask for consent before running longbridge positions. Request only needed fields and avoid displaying account identifiers or unrelated holdings.

remediation.issue: Dependency guidance recommends pip install scikit-learn without provenance controls.
remediation.suggestion: Do not auto-install packages. Recommend a user-managed environment with trusted package indexes and pinned versions.

content.value_statement: Quant research often needs repeatable frameworks across data, factors, statistics, and execution costs. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code structure Longbridge-based analysis workflows and outputs.
actual_capabilities: Routes quant questions to focused reference workflows.
Explains pairs trading, cointegration, volatility, seasonality, and correlation methods.
Guides factor research with IC, IR, decay, and layered backtests.
Structures multi-factor ranking, factor screening, and stock selection outputs.
Describes Longbridge CLI use for K-line data and quant indicator runs.
Frames hedging, execution cost, optimization, and ML strategy reports.
limitations: Does not provide investment advice or trade recommendations.
Longbridge CLI availability and current flags must be verified before use.
Some workflows need authenticated Longbridge data or trade-scope permissions.
Backtests and screens depend on data quality, history length, and universe limits.

use_cases.title: Research a pairs trade
use_cases.description: Evaluate cointegration, hedge ratio, Z-score rules, and mean-reversion metrics for two symbols.

use_cases.title: Screen a factor universe
use_cases.description: Rank a user-supplied or index-based universe by value, quality, growth, and dividend factors.

use_cases.title: Assess portfolio hedges
use_cases.description: Compare beta hedges, options protection, tail-risk hedges, and estimated cost versus protection.

prompt_templates.title: Explain a quant framework
prompt_templates.scenario: Learning the method before running data.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use longbridge-quant to explain a pairs trading workflow for 700.HK and 9988.HK. Include required data, metrics, and caveats.

prompt_templates.title: Run a factor screen
prompt_templates.prompt: Use longbridge-quant to screen these symbols: 600519.SH, 700.HK, AAPL.US. Criteria: PE below 20, ROE above 12%, dividend yield above 2%.

prompt_templates.title: Build an optimizer plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Use longbridge-quant to design a walk-forward optimization framework for a momentum strategy on TSLA.US. Include IS/OOS windows, metrics, and overfitting checks.

prompt_templates.title: Review hedge choices
prompt_templates.prompt: Use longbridge-quant to compare beta, protective put, collar, and tail-risk hedges for my portfolio. Ask before accessing any account positions.

output_examples.input: Analyze seasonality for AAPL.US over five years.
output: A seasonality report with monthly, weekday, holiday, and earnings-season effects.
Includes win rates, signal direction, top patterns, and data limitations.

output_examples.input: Create a multi-factor ranking for my symbol list.
output: A ranked summary with value, momentum, quality, low-volatility, and composite scores.
Includes factor attribution, missing-data notes, and Longbridge data-source citation.

output_examples.input: Plan a hedge for a technology portfolio.
output: A hedge memo comparing beta hedge, protective put, collar, and tail-risk alternatives.
Includes cost, protection level, scenario results, and risk caveats.

best_practices: Confirm Longbridge command flags before running any CLI workflow.
Ask for user consent before using authenticated data or sending strategy scripts.
Label all outputs as research support, not investment advice.
anti_patterns: Do not run user-supplied scripts without confirming what will be sent.
Do not treat backtest performance as a forward-looking guarantee.
Do not fetch portfolio positions unless the user explicitly requests account-level analysis.

faq.question: Does this skill place trades?
faq.answer: No. It provides research frameworks and analysis outputs. Trading actions are outside its documented scope.

faq.question: Does it require a Longbridge login?
faq.answer: Many public data workflows do not. Portfolio positions and some account data require login and user permission.

faq.question: Can it run custom indicator scripts?
faq.answer: Yes, the quant workflow describes server-side indicator script runs through Longbridge. Users should confirm before sending proprietary logic.

faq.question: What markets does it cover?
faq.answer: It references US, HK, and A-share examples, depending on Longbridge data availability.

faq.question: Is the output investment advice?
faq.answer: No. Outputs are research support and should include a clear investment-risk caveat.

faq.question: Can Claude, Codex, and Claude Code use it?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code compatible workflows.
